6: Final Stand [BESEECH] - The standard's deity comes to your aid for 30 seconds, ensuring that all incoming blows will be subject to Divine Bulwark's abilities.  Can be activated while incapacitated or in roundtime.  1 use per day.

There should be some representation of the five claws of Uhlgeer, the she-bear, and corresponding crimson drops that represent the blood her claws can bring to the surface.  Droplets can be made of paint, enamel, lacquer, jewels, etc.  Above all, it must have a reflective surface of some kind.  If creating a ring, you may use uhl-ring. The Wisdom vissi can be added to a vissi artifact in order to augment the artifact with custom abilities.  Each vissi artifact may hold up to 5 different types of vissi, and each vissi may be upgradable by adding additional vissi of the same type to the artifact.
The Wisdom vissi is named Wisdom and it is a Primal vissi.
This vissi notes the following ability information:
Bestows wisdom to the wielder, making
adventures echo powerfully, granting bonus
experience.

The vissi may have abilities you can activate by using certain verbs (RUB, TAP, PUSH, PULL, or POKE) on the vissi artifact you add them to.  In order to set the activator, use ATTEND on the vissi.  The vissi might not have an ability you may activate, in which case ATTEND will indicate that.

Sometimes, a vissi may have multiple abilities you can activate with the activator verbs.  You can TILT the vissi to switch between them.  Tilt will not respond if the vissi has only a single ability (or no abilities at all).  You may only have one ability active at a time.

In addition, the vissi may have abilities with customizable messaging options.  You can TURN the vissi to customize each set of options.  Once on a set of options, you can TWIST the vissi to cycle through the available customizations.
Finally, some vissi may contain ambient messaging, which you can toggle on or off with COVER.
It is currently tier 1.  The maximum tier is 6.  It is empowered by 1 thread.
The Wisdom vissi will cost 40,000,000 coins.
